title: The Connection
cardAlt: Two-story home with charcoal siding, stone, standing-seam metal roof and a wraparound porch with cedar posts
tagline: Distinguishing the joint, preserving the vision.
heroAlt: Two-story home with charcoal siding, stone, standing-seam metal roof and a wraparound porch with cedar posts
paragraphs: Connecting the existing gymnasium barn to a new residence presented a unique architectural challenge, resolved through a cohesive design that brings both structures together. Above the garage, a private living space offers a sense of separation and retreat, culminating in a third-floor patio with expansive views—a rewarding destination at the top of the home.

A modern farmhouse composed of dark board-and-batten siding, stone accents, a standing-seam metal roof and timber posts at the covered porch. Inside, light oak floors run throughout, and the kitchen combines a charcoal island, warm wood cabinetry, a brass range hood and black-framed windows. In the great room, a paneled fireplace wall is flanked by oak built-ins with a wine fridge, and a soaring window wall brings in the landscape.

gallery.alt: Rear of the home under an overcast sky: dark board-and-batten wing with a tall glass bay, timber-framed entry, sage-green wing with metal roof, concrete patio and new landscaping
Primary bath with two wood vanities, brass mirrors and sconces, a central glass shower with patterned tile and black herringbone floor
Open kitchen with walnut cabinetry, charcoal island, brass range hood, built-in glass-front cabinets and a black herringbone-tile column
Two-story living room with a tall charcoal paneled fireplace flanked by light oak built-in shelves and a wine fridge
Living room with a tall window wall facing mature pines, wide-plank light oak floors, a tall charcoal paneled fireplace with built-in cabinets, and the kitchen beyond

Front of the home: charcoal siding and board-and-batten, two-car garage with green barn lights, stone base, standing-seam metal awning with cedar bracket, and a cedar-post entry beside the sage-green wing
